saw_lines: Teams buying brand systems judge the tool on whether their people keep using it after the first month.
So the deal is won on the homepage, where a buyer decides in seconds if this fits their team.
Your 4 Google creatives, 1 video and 3 text, are your only paid proof, so put one customer result number on the video and link your social channels from the homepage.
ads_1: Google video and text ads leading with the brand engine, not the platform.
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
